title: Offthread: Anonymous AI Chat, No Login, No-History Mode
excerpt: Anonymous AI chat with no login or account. Use Temporary chat for no history, or keep chats only in your browser. Prompts still reach a model provider.
content_html:
No account needed, and free models are included. Redaction can miss things, so check what you send.

Attach files (up to 3. Images are resized; other files up to 1.3 MB)Enable web search. OpenAI’s search tool may retain search data under separate terms.

Emails, phone numbers, keys and names are swapped for placeholders in your browser before anything is sent. Click to turn off.Chats are kept only in this browser, not in an account. Click to switch to temporary chats.

Fast: Answers right away

Type a message or attach a file to send

How it works

  1. Redacted on your deviceEmails, phone numbers and keys become placeholders. View redaction source

  2. Processed by a modelProviders agree not to train on your prompts or replies.

  3. Restored on your deviceYour real values go back into the answer.

Preview what the model sees

Your draft
Draft a reply to dana@example.com about moving our meeting.

Model sees
Draft a reply to [EMAIL_1] about moving our meeting.

OpenAI may keep limited data for safety review. Web search may fall outside the retention agreement. Privacy details
